title: Ask the Handbook
mission: Answer staff questions from fictional internal guides, quoting the source, and say "I don't know" when the guides do not cover it.
steps: Load the guides and show them as a searchable list with title and date.
Search: rank guides by how many of the question's words they contain.
Answer with one quoted sentence and its guide, skipping guides that were replaced.
Refuse when the evidence is too weak, and prefer the newest guide when two disagree.
checks: Every answer quotes a sentence that really exists in the cited guide.
Questions the guides do not cover get an honest "no answer", not a guess.
An outdated or replaced guide is never cited when a newer one answers the question.
validation: Explain your evidence threshold and show a question that sits just below it.
extension: Let an LLM rephrase the quoted answer, then reject replies containing numbers the guide does not contain.
hint: Start with search for a single word such as "phishing". Use the stopword list in handbook.json so everyone counts words the same way.
